messages.subject: GSOC 2017
messages.body_plain:
Sir,
     I am interested in machine learning. I built a scheduling system for charging of electric vehicles in a smart grid. I used nnet and neuralnet to generate neural network and then test them against actual data available. I have developed android applications for my institute and pushed them to github. I am interested in extending caffe to R. I am interested in finding mentors to guide me.

my github link:
https://github.com/SriramRamesh
